Shravan Kumar on JDU BJP Alliance : bihar men JDU se achanak aaya bahut bara apdet !| Bihar Breaking News
JDU ke varishth neta aur bihar sarkar ke gramin vikas mantri shravan kumar ne ek bara bayan diya hai.. unhonne kaha ki MLC chunav ke bad JDU aur BJP ke rishte men kuchh khatas aaee hai.. iski samiksha shirsh netritv ne ki hai.. jald uspar kam hoga sab thik ho jaega.. hal hi men bihar men vidhan parishad (MLC) chunav ke parinamon aur rajnitik ghatnakramon ke bad jediyu (JDU) aur bijepi (BJP) ke bich rishton men ek bar phir talkhi aur khatas ki khabren samne aaee hain.
